objectives.description: An ambiguous day-of-month must be resolved by asking, never by assuming a month.

_mock_runs: Hangi ayın 3'ü olduğunu teyit edelim: Eylül'ün 3'ü mü?

_mock_negative_runs.label: never_books

metadata.note: 'Ayın 3'ü' is how Turkish callers actually give dates, and silently resolving it to the nearest month is a booking error nobody notices until the day.
